Arrange the following words alphabetically as in a dictionary:

A. Enthusiasm
B. Ephemeral
C. Enterprise
D. Entrench
E. Exhilarate
Choose the numeral pair which is odd and different from others.
In a certain code, 3456 is written as ROPE and 15526 is written as APPLE. How is 54613 written in the same code?
Pointing to a man, Sujata said, "His son is my son's maternal uncle." How is the man related to Sujata?
Choose the correct mirror image of the figure (X) from amongst the four alternatives.
Choose the most appropriate water image of the adjoining figure (X).

Arrange the following words in a meaningful sequence:

A. Consultation
B. Illness
C. Doctor
D. Treatment
E. Recovery

If a cube is coloured red on all faces and cut into 64 smaller cubes of equal size, then which of the following are correct?

A. Sixteen small cubes have no face coloured.
B. Twenty four small cubes have only one face coloured.
C. None of the cubes can have its opposite faces coloured red.
D. There are eight cubes which have three faces coloured.
Three different positions of same dice are given below. The number opposite to the number 2 is:

Six students A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a play ground. A and B are from Nehru hostel while the rest belong to Azad hostel. D and F are tall while the others are short. A, C and D are wearing glasses while the others are not. In reference to the above information, which of the following statements are correct?

A. Students B and E are short and not wearing glasses.
B. E belongs to Azad hostel, is short and does not wear glasses.
C. F belongs to Nehru hostel, is short and wearing glasses.
D. C belongs to Azad hostel, is short and not wearing glasses.

Nine friends J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are watching a cricket match in a stadium. Seated in a row, L is at the immediate right of M and at third place at the right of N. K is at one end of row. Q is seated adjacent to both O and P. O is at the third place at the left of K. J is right next to left of O.

Who is sitting between N and M?
Choose one word out of the given alternatives, which can not be formed from the letters of the word "CONSULTATION".
What will be the value of $x$ as per the following figures?

Two statements are given below, followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from the commonly known facts and decide which of the given conclusions logically follow from the given statements.

Statements: Some bottles are drinks. All drinks are cups.

Conclusions:
I. Some bottles are cups
II. Some cups are drinks
III. All drinks are bottles
IV. All cups are drinks.
In a row of thirty boys, A is tenth from the right and B is seventh from the left end. How many boys are there between A and C, if C is third to the right of B?
By applying which of the following meanings of arithmetical signs, will the value of the expression $[800-10\div\frac{1}{2}\times35+75]$ be zero?
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

In the following letter series,

PMT, OOS, NQR, MSQ, ? , .......

identify the next term (?) among the following alternatives:

In the following figure, circle represents sports persons, square represents unmarried persons, triangle represents women and rectangle represents educated persons. The number which represents unmarried educated sports women is:

Which of the following statements are correct?

A. Needle is related to thread in the same way as pen is related to ink.
B. Doctor is related to patient in the same way as lawyer is related to Magistrate.
C. Drama is related to Director in the same way as Magazine is related to Editor.
D. Science is related to Laboratory in the same way as Astronomy is related to Observatory.

All the six members of a family A, B, C, D, E and F are travelling together. B is son of C but C is not mother of B. A and C are married couple. E is the brother of C. D is the daughter of A. F is the brother of B.

In reference to the above information, which of the following are correct.

A. E is uncle of D.
B. A is the mother of B.
C. A has two children.
D. There are four males in the family.

The door of Akshita's house faces the east. From the back side of her house, she walks straight 50 metres, then turns to the right and walks 50 metres again. Finally, she turns towards left and stops after walking 25 metres. Now, Akshita is in which direction from the starting point?
